items.summary: Anthropic says its beta Life Sciences Verification Program gives verified teams access to models with more permissive biology safeguards. Access is available through its first-party API console and Claude Enterprise and Team plans; individual plans, third-party platforms, and BAA-enabled organizations are excluded. The program monitors usage against approved use cases and requires 30-day data retention, with retained data excluded from model training.
items.relevance: Interpretation: The program could reduce interruptions for legitimate biology research, while verification, monitoring, retention requirements, and availability restrictions may shape which institutions can adopt it.
items.title: Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
